title: Duplicate out-of-bounds bug in hash-based channel selection
description:
File: rust/lichen-core/src/lib.rs
Line: 166

select_channel_with_gnss hash-based path (priority 2) contains identical flawed logic: let n = n_channels.max(3); return 1 + (h % (n-1) as u32) as u8. Same out-of-bounds behavior when n_channels < 3. This is code duplication of the bug at line 103.
close_reason: Fixed duplicate out-of-bounds bug in hash-based channel selection (line 166). Removed faulty n_channels.max(3) clamping that returned invalid channel indices when n_channels < 3. Now returns channel 0 when n_channels < 2 (no data channels available), otherwise correctly computes 1 + (h % (n_channels - 1)) for valid range [1, n_channels-1]. Same fix applied to synchronized_hop_channel (line 103). Updated test to verify correct behavior.
